title: Why Palm Jaggery?
subtitle: The Sweet Truth About Natural Sweeteners

sections.title: What is Palm Jaggery?
sections.content: Palm jaggery is an unrefined sweetener made by slowly reducing the sap of palm trees. Unlike white sugar, it undergoes minimal processing and retains the minerals naturally present in the sap.

sections.title: Nutritional Benefits
sections.content: Palm jaggery is rich in iron, magnesium, potassium, and calcium. It also contains antioxidants and has a lower glycemic index compared to refined sugar, making it a better choice for blood sugar management.

sections.title: Why We Choose Palm Jaggery
sections.content: We use palm jaggery not just for its health benefits, but also for its unique flavor profile. It adds a rich, caramel-like sweetness that enhances the overall taste of our cookies while providing natural nutrition.

sections.title: The Thekua Connection
sections.content: Thekua is a traditional Indian cookie from Bihar and Jharkhand, traditionally made during festivals. Our modern take on this classic recipe uses palm jaggery as the primary sweetener, staying true to its roots while making it healthier.
